name: Dev Tools
description: Sandboxed, offline, zero permissions — 32 tools at ~100KB: generators (password/QR/barcode/ID/lorem), codecs (Base64/URL/escape/image), crypto (hash/HMAC/JWT/AES), text tools (JSON/diff/case/lines/mojibake) and more.
releaseNotes: 32 tools: password/ID/lorem/QR/barcode/RSA generators, Base64/URL/escape/image codecs, image compressor, hash & HMAC, JWT decode & sign, AES, certificate decoder, RMB uppercase, JSON formatter, text diff, regex tester, case/line/invisible-char/mojibake tools, timestamp & date calc, file size, number base, semver, color & contrast, chmod.
